name: Physical DoT (Bleed)
summary: A physical damage-over-time shell that inflicts Bleeding from big physical hits and scales the resulting bleed tick rather than the hit itself — the hit exists mainly to apply/refresh the ailment. This is the clearest 'dead stats' showcase in the knowledge base: several stats that look essential for a hit-based attack (attack speed, critical strike multiplier) do close to nothing once damage is actually coming from the ongoing bleed instead of the hit.

signals.description: Main skill is a physical-damage skill commonly built around applying and scaling Bleeding rather than its own hit damage.
Nonzero, meaningful Bleed DPS in PoB's calc output confirms the build is actually generating bleed damage, not just using a skill that happens to be capable of it.
Gladiator's bleed-focused ascendancy notables (stacking multiple bleeds per enemy, bleeding on crit) make it the most common home for this archetype, though it isn't strictly required.
The bulk of total damage coming from the bleed tick rather than the hit itself is what makes attack-speed/hit-scaling stats 'dead' for this archetype.

scalingVectors.mechanic: Base physical hit damage that applies/refreshes the bleed
scalingVectors.explanation: Bleed magnitude derives from the physical hit damage of the hit that inflicted it, so raw physical hit damage (gem level, weapon physical damage, 'increased Physical Damage') still matters — but only as the base the bleed reads from, not as damage dealt directly.

scalingVectors.mechanic: Damage over Time multiplier / 'increased Damage with Bleeding'
scalingVectors.explanation: This is the direct multiplier on the ongoing bleed tick and the main lever once the physical-hit base is established — gem, tree, and gear sources of 'increased Damage over Time' and bleed-specific damage both apply here.

scalingVectors.mechanic: Chance to Bleed (Gladiator's guaranteed bleed on crit, bleed-chance supports)
scalingVectors.explanation: Consistently applying the ailment at all — not just once — is what turns a hit skill into a DoT-carrying skill. This is a consistency/threshold lever, not a scaling one.
Bleeding deals substantially more damage per second while the bled target is moving rather than standing still — a real damage lever the build can exploit or lose based on enemy behavior, not gear.

deadStats.reason: Once bleed is applied and refreshing, the ongoing tick doesn't scale with attack speed at all — attack speed only affects how quickly the ailment is re-applied (relevant to uptime, not magnitude), so heavy attack-speed investment mostly doesn't pay off the way it would on a pure hit-based build.

Critical Strike Multiplier does not affect Bleeding damage by default — only the Perfect Agony keystone converts it into a Damage-over-Time multiplier for ailments, so plain crit multiplier investment is dead without that keystone.
Bleed is always Physical damage regardless of the hit's damage-type composition (unless explicitly converted) — 'increased Fire/Cold/Lightning damage' rolls do nothing for the bleed tick.

layers: Whatever the base class/ascendancy provides — this archetype's identity is entirely offensive, so defenses are typically bolted on (life, evasion/armour from gear) rather than synergistic with the DoT mechanic
Ailment avoidance/immunity to avoid being bled back
Standard hit-avoidance layers (evasion, armour) with no archetype-specific bonus
characteristicWeaknesses: No inherent defensive layer comes from the offense mechanic itself, unlike Righteous Fire (regen) or armour stacking (mitigation) — defense is an entirely separate budget line.
Builds chasing 'always bleed'/crit-bleed setups sometimes under-invest in raw survivability because so much of the build's complexity budget goes into the offense mechanic.

failureModes.symptom: TotalDPS is high on paper but actual damage against tanky single targets feels weak
failureModes.diagnosis: Bleed DPS may be low relative to Total DPS — the total looks fine because the hit itself is doing real damage, masking that the DoT component (which should be the main damage source for this archetype) isn't scaled.
failureModes.fix: Check BleedDPS specifically, not just TotalDPS; invest in 'increased Damage over Time'/'increased Damage with Bleeding' rather than more hit-damage multipliers if BleedDPS is a small fraction of the total.

failureModes.diagnosis: Bleed deals significantly more damage against moving targets — a build tuned against moving trash can look much weaker against bosses that stand still.
failureModes.fix: Don't tune damage expectations purely off leveling/clear damage; check boss-context (stationary-target) bleed numbers or accept the single-target drop and shore it up with a secondary damage source.

failureModes.symptom: Character invests heavily in attack speed / added crit multiplier but DPS barely moves
failureModes.diagnosis: Attack speed and crit multiplier are largely dead stats for this archetype without Perfect Agony — investment is going to the wrong lever.
failureModes.fix: Redirect investment to Damage over Time multiplier, chance-to-bleed consistency, and base physical hit damage instead.
